name: notify-control help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:notify-control (the Notifications panel).
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Notifications
entries.text: Every notification the console, AmberX and axHub can send. Each one has its own switch, channels, priority and a test button.

entries.title: Notifications
entries.text: Opens the Notifications panel.

entries.title: Notifications
entries.text: The same panel, inside Settings.

entries.title: All notifications
entries.text: The master switch. Off silences everything except approvals and veto notices, so you can still stop a held call.

entries.title: Quiet hours
entries.text: Holds phone pushes, sound and pop-ups during these hours, except urgent ones and approvals. A held alert that's still open reaches the phone when they end.

entries.title: Find a notification
entries.text: Filters the list by name, id or where it comes from.

entries.title: Test
entries.text: Sends a real test of this notification down its current channels and says where it went. It clears by itself after 90 seconds.

entries.title: Reset
entries.text: Puts this notification back to its defaults.

entries.title: Reset everything
entries.text: Puts every notification, the master switch and the app switches back to their defaults. Quiet hours stay as they are.

entries.title: Priority
entries.text: Low shows in the banner only. Normal uses every channel that's on and waits out quiet hours. High uses a stronger tone and pop-up. Urgent also goes through quiet hours.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves the quiet hours times.

entries.title: Quiet from
entries.text: The time of day quiet hours start or end, in your time zone. Press Save after changing it.

entries.title: Quiet until
entries.text: The time of day quiet hours start or end, in your time zone. Press Save after changing it.

entries.title: Take it out of the group
entries.text: Removes this notification type from the group. The type itself keeps its own settings.

entries.title: Add a type
entries.text: Pick a notification type to put in this group. A type can be in more than one group.

entries.title: Button
entries.text: The words on the command button.

entries.title: Does
entries.text: What the button does: open the call's approval screen, open a screen, or run a console action.

entries.title: Add a command
entries.text: Adds a button to every notification in this group.

entries.title: Save group
entries.text: Saves the group. Its on or off switch and its commands apply at once.

entries.title: New group
entries.text: Starts a group of your own: any types, switched on or off together.

entries.title: Trigger name
entries.text: A name you'll recognise. It shows in Sent and blocked lately when this rule holds something.

entries.title: What it does
entries.text: Only send when it passes, mute when it passes, or send a new notification when it passes.

entries.title: At least
entries.text: Watch this severity and anything worse.

entries.title: Source
entries.text: Watch only notifications from this source, for example ci.

entries.title: Key starts with
entries.text: Watch only notifications whose key begins with this.

entries.title: Field
entries.text: What to test: title, body, severity, source, key, type, priority, app, or meta.<name> for a value the sender attached.

entries.title: Value
entries.text: What the field is tested against. At least and at most need a number.

entries.title: Add a condition
entries.text: Adds a test. Every condition has to hold for the rule to pass.

entries.title: Fires from the Nth time
entries.text: The rule passes from this match on, counted inside the minutes next to it. 1 passes every time.

entries.title: Within minutes
entries.text: How far back matches count towards the threshold.

entries.title: From
entries.text: The rule passes only after this time. Leave both times empty for all day.

entries.title: Until
entries.text: The rule passes only before this time. Past midnight works, like 22:00 to 07:00.

entries.title: Notification title
entries.text: The title of the notification this rule sends.

entries.title: Notification text
entries.text: Its text. Empty uses the title of the notification that set it off.

entries.title: Severity
entries.text: How loud the new notification is.

entries.title: Save trigger
entries.text: Saves the rule. It applies to the next notification and its count starts again.

entries.title: New trigger
entries.text: Starts a rule for when a notification fires: event, conditions, threshold and schedule.
